solution: (i) $\\tan 3\\theta=\\frac{\\tan\\theta+\\tan 2\\theta}{1-\\tan\\theta\\tan 2\\theta}$ with $\\tan 2\\theta=\\frac{2t}{1-t^{2}}$ ($t=\\tan\\theta$); simplifying gives $\\frac{3t-t^{3}}{1-3t^{2}}$. (ii) $\\tan 3\\theta=\\tan\\theta$ means $\\frac{3t-t^{3}}{1-3t^{2}}=t$, so $3t-t^{3}=t-3t^{3}$ i.e. $2t+2t^{3}=0\\Rightarrow 2t(1+t^{2})=0$, so $t=0$. Thus $\\theta=0$ (and by periodicity the solutions in $[0,\\pi)$ are $0$ and $\\pi$ is excluded; also $\\theta$ where denominators vanish give $\\tan 3\\theta$ undefined — check separately: $\\theta=\\pi/6,5\\pi/6$ make $1-3t^{2}=0$, at which $\\tan3\\theta$ is infinite while $\\tan\\theta$ finite, so not solutions). Hence $\\theta=0$.
